newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Japan wants insurance deal with U.S. this week.
newsitem.headline: Japan wants insurance deal with U.S. this week.

text.p: Japanese foreign minister Yukihiko Ikeda told acting U.S. Trade Representative Charlene Barshefsky that he wants the two countries to settle the dispute over insurance this week, a Japanese foreign ministry official said on Wednesday.
Bashefsky will go to Tokyo for last ditch insurance talks with Japanese Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka after leaving the World Trade Organisation ministerial conference which concludes on Friday.
The Japanese official quoted Barshefsky as saying: 'I am negotiating in a good relatship with minister Mitsuzuka. Let's see what happens'.
The U.S. and Japan are trying to settle a long running dispute over liberalisation of Japan's insurance sector ahead of a December 15 deadline.
